newsitem.title: UK: NWE oil products mostly steady.
newsitem.headline: NWE oil products mostly steady.

text.p: NWE oil products were mostly steady on Thursday, with gas oil slightly firmer, traders said.
Gas firmed 25 cents but cargo premiums were stable, at around Jan IPE +$5 for 0.2 percent heating oil. Barges were dormant.
Naphtha was steady but scant buying saw little premium for paraffinic over a balanced to oversupplied full range market.
Gasoline steadied after a refinery fire lifted U.S. spot markets, but tight arb profitabilty continued to limited trade.
High sulphur fuel steadied, but was quiet. Low sulphur continued to slip, pulled down by weaker paper.
